message.content: {"10535_8353800725015": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The chest X-rays demonstrate bilateral, relatively symmetrical air-space opacities concentrated in the mid and lower lung zones with sparing of the apices, a pattern classically associated with diffuse alveolar hemorrhage seen in Goodpasture's syndrome."}, "10535_8353800725069": {"answer": "B", "reason": "The radiological findings show bilateral symmetrical air-space opacities that predominantly affect the mid and lower zones while sparing the apices and costophrenic angles, which supports the diagnosis of pulmonary hemorrhage in Goodpasture's syndrome."}, "10535_8353800828067": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The imaging reveals bilateral symmetrical air-space opacities located primarily in the mid and lower zones with apical sparing, a distribution characteristic of the alveolar hemorrhage associated with Goodpasture's syndrome."}}
